items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Lorenzo Stahls on guitar, you heard of him.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band with Ori at that time, can you remember?

With Ori at that time, we had Kid Ori, had Mutt Carrier, you heard of Mutt? And Mutt Carrier, trumpet, Johnny Dots, a clarinet, Emile Big Eye on violin, they used violin then, see. Lorenzo Stahls on guitar, you heard of him. Lorenzo Stahls and Eddie Gardner. Oh, on bass. Yes, that was his band. Yeah, that was his band.
Lorenzo Stahls and Eddie Gardner. How many years is that before you went to California that you first played with Ori, do you know?
